    public ValueTask SendNotification(string method, JsonElement? parameters = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

    private async ValueTask<T> Invoke<T, TParams>(string method, TParams parameters, bool includeParameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed != 0, this);
        using var linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(_lifetime.Token, cancellationToken);
        string id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        var response = await _transport.Send(CreateRequest(method, id, parameters, includeParameters), false, linked.Token).NoSync();
        linked.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        JsonElement result = ReadResponse(response, id);
        if (result.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null && default(T) is null && typeof(T) != typeof(JsonElement))
            throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("RPC result cannot be null.");
        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize(result, JsonTypes.Get<T>(_options))!;
    }
    private async ValueTask Notify<TParams>(string method, TParams parameters, bool includeParameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken)

    private JsonElement CreateRequest<TParams>(string method, string? id, TParams parameters, bool includeParameters)

    private static JsonElement CreateResponse(JsonElement id, JsonElement result, Exception? exception)
    {
        using var buffer = new PooledJsonBuffer();
        using (var writer = new Utf8JsonWriter(buffer))

            if (exception is null) { writer.WritePropertyName("result"u8); result.WriteTo(writer); }

                writer.WriteNumber("code"u8, exception is JsonRpcException rpc ? rpc.Code : exception is JsonException ? -32602 : -32603);

            writer.WriteEndObject();

    private static void CheckEnvelope(JsonElement root)
    {
        if (root.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Expected an RPC object.");
        var names = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var property in root.EnumerateObject())
            if (!names.Add(property.Name)) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Duplicate envelope member: " + property.Name);
        bool hasVersion = root.TryGetProperty("jsonrpc", out var version);
        if ((IncludeVersion && !hasVersion) || (hasVersion && (version.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String || version.GetString() != "2.0")))
            throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Expected JSON-RPC version 2.0.");
    }
    private static JsonElement ReadResponse(JsonElement? response, string expectedId)
    {
        if (response is not { } root) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Response is missing.");
        CheckEnvelope(root);
        if (!root.TryGetProperty("id", out var id)) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Response ID is missing.");
        bool matchingId = id.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String && id.GetString() == expectedId;
        bool hasResult = root.TryGetProperty("result", out var result);
        bool hasError = root.TryGetProperty("error", out var error);
        if (hasResult == hasError) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Response must contain exactly one of result or error.");
        if (hasError)
        {
            if (error.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object ||
                !error.TryGetProperty("code", out var code) || code.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Number || !code.TryGetInt64(out long codeValue) ||
                !error.TryGetProperty("message", out var message) || message.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String)
                throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Malformed JSON-RPC error.");
            var names = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var property in error.EnumerateObject())
                if (!names.Add(property.Name)) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Duplicate error member.");
            if (!matchingId && !(id.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null && codeValue is -32700 or -32600))
                throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Response ID does not match the request.");
            throw new JsonRpcException(codeValue, message.GetString()!, error.TryGetProperty("data", out var data) ? data.Clone() : null);
        }
        if (!matchingId) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Response ID does not match the request.");
        return result;
    }
    private async Task Dispatch(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            await foreach (JsonElement message in _transport.ReadMessages(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
            {
                CheckEnvelope(message);
                if (!message.TryGetProperty("method", out var methodElement) || methodElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String)
                    throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Incoming method is missing.");
                string method = methodElement.GetString()!;
                JsonElement parameters = message.TryGetProperty("params", out var p) ? p : EmptyObject;
                if (message.TryGetProperty("id", out var id))
                {
                    if (id.ValueKind is not (JsonValueKind.String or JsonValueKind.Number)) throw new JsonRpcProtocolException("Invalid server request ID.");

                    try { result = await HandleRequest(method, parameters, cancellationToken).NoSync(); }

                    catch (Exception exception) { failure = exception; }
                    await _transport.WriteResponse(CreateResponse(id, result, failure), cancellationToken).NoSync();
                }
                else switch (method)

                    default: UnknownNotification?.Invoke(method, parameters.Clone()); break;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) { }
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) != 0) return;
        await _lifetime.CancelAsync().NoSync();
